_comment: APPROVED BLOG POST MERGES, DESCRIBED ONCE.
Each entry retires the near-duplicate post `from` in favour of the post `to` that stays.
This file is the single source for both halves of a merge:
src/lib/public-blog.ts                  <from> is never built, listed, paginated or related
scripts/blog-merges.js                  the same exclusion for the search index (and so llms.txt) and RSS
One list is what keeps the redirect and the build from disagreeing. The 2026-10-22 merges were
approved in the redirect script alone, so their source posts kept shipping as HTTP 200 pages and
kept their sitemap entries; a URL that 301s must never be advertised.
Setting each `from` post to draft in the blog studio is separate owner cleanup for the other
readers of /api/seo-tools/blog-public. Nothing here depends on it.
Add an entry only with the owner's approval and only when `to` is published.
